hooks.name: on-legacy-drop
hooks.description: When a legacy source file is saved under samples/, run the static autopsy and write its EARS requirements next to the spec so Kiro can pick them up.

action.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("file_path", ""))'); [ -n "$f" ] && cargo run --quiet --release --bin necro-cli -- autopsy "$f" --requirements > ".kiro/specs/autopsy-$(basename "${f%.*}").md"
